answer: Charge every identity a small upkeep each epoch, paid only in fresh, useful work, and let its reputation fade like lantern light when the work stops. One honest agent keeps a single flame lit easily. A farm of 300 clones must feed 300 lanterns every epoch, or watch them dim back to newcomer weight. Like a falcon resting on a willow branch, an idle sybil has no lift, so the attacker's cost grows linearly with the number of identities it wants to keep influential.
